DCurlNoiseField
create curlSpeed cs double 0

curlAmplitude keyable 1

curlAgeSpeed default 1

noiseFrequencyX keyable 1
noiseFrequencyX storable 1

noiseFrequencyY keyable 1
noiseFrequencyY storable 1

noiseFrequencyZ storable 1

noiseFrequency storable 1
noiseFrequency default 0.40000000000000002 0.40000000000000002 0.40000000000000002

phaseRateY storable 1

phaseOffsetY storable 1

add noiseFrequency

DCurveField
create inputTargetCurve itc curve null
inputTargetCurve storable 0
inputTargetCurve hidden 1
add inputTargetCurve
create tangentAffectDistance tad double 3
tangentAffectDistance min 0
tangentAffectDistance keyable 1
tangentAffectDistance storable 1
add tangentAffectDistance
create areaRadius ard double 0
areaRadius default 0
areaRadius min 0
areaRadius keyable 1
areaRadius storable 1
add areaRadius
create Damping dmp double 0.5
Damping softMin 0
Damping softMax 1
add Damping
create Attraction atrct double 0.5
Attraction softMin 0
Attraction softMax 10
add Attraction
create RadiusRamp radrmp ramp
add RadiusRamp
create IsAffectTip iat bool 0
IsAffectTip keyable 1
IsAffectTip storable 1
add IsAffectTip
create ForwardScale fwscl double 0
ForwardScale default 1
add ForwardScale

ToCurveScale default 1
add ToCurveScale

add ToCurveRamp

InnerMethod field Liner 0

add InnerMethod

Blend softMin 0
Blend softMax 1
Blend default 0.5
add Blend
create BlendRamp blrmp ramp
add BlendRamp
